name: Carbon-24
description: About 10,000 carbon structures with up to 24 atoms per cell (CDVAE split). In the MEIDNet paper it is the second structure-representation generalization test; no property modality and no checkpoint here.
citation: Pickard, Carbon-24 (2020); Xie et al., ICLR 2022 (CDVAE)
role: published: structure-representation generalization (not a multimodal benchmark)
